name: ditto-plugins
description: Claude Code plugin marketplace for Ditto - the peer-to-peer sync platform

plugins.name: ditto-dql
plugins.description: DQL (Ditto Query Language) assistance for writing queries, subscriptions, and data operations

plugins.name: ditto-mesh
plugins.description: Ditto mesh networking and transport configuration — transports, peer discovery, runtime config updates, and transport-aware data modeling

plugins.name: ditto-subscriptions
plugins.description: How Ditto sync subscriptions work: query rules and limitations, mesh propagation, multi-hop flooding, and troubleshooting missing documents

plugins.name: ditto-data-modeling
plugins.description: CRDT-aware data modeling for Ditto: REGISTER/MAP/COUNTER/ATTACHMENT semantics, embed vs split decisions, document size budgets, and JSON review across SDK 4.14.x and 5.x

plugins.name: ditto-data-streams
plugins.description: Ditto Data Streams (preview): low-latency, bidirectional raw-byte channels between peers over named topics — lifecycle, candidate ownership, reliability, NGN setup, and troubleshooting. Language-agnostic; pairs with the Kotlin and Swift SDK skills

plugins.name: ditto-kotlin
plugins.description: Ditto Kotlin SDK assistance — Android and JVM apps: Gradle setup, connecting, authentication, transports, subscriptions, DQL execution, observers with coroutines/Flow, attachments, presence, and testing. Covers Ditto SDK 4.14.x (LTS), 5.0.x, 5.1.x and 5.2.0

plugins.name: ditto-swift
plugins.description: Build runnable SwiftUI apps and integrate or troubleshoot the Ditto Swift SDK on iOS, iPadOS, macOS and Mac Catalyst. Includes Xcode project generation, diagnostics, lifecycle and concurrency guidance for SDK 4.14.x, 5.0.x, 5.1.x and 5.2.0.

plugins.name: ditto-js
plugins.description: Build and troubleshoot Ditto JavaScript/TypeScript apps on Node.js, web/React, React Native and Expo, with tested provider patterns and shared native configuration.

plugins.name: ditto-native-config
plugins.description: Reusable Ditto Apple and Android app permissions, plist, entitlements, manifest and runtime permission guidance.

plugins.name: ditto-csharp
plugins.description: Ditto C#/.NET SDK guidance and runnable Console, Windows Forms, MAUI, Uno and Avalonia starters. Native targets, async programming, DQL, observers, deployment and testing; Ditto 4.14.x through 5.2.0.
